main_text.l: ראשון m. Prior, Primus. Est & cum Joth loco Aleph, ריִשׁון Job.8.8. & cum utraque litera ראישון Num primus, Job. 15.7, ubi alter-utrà redundat: Plur. ראשנים. Fœminínum ראשונה Prior, Prima: Prius, Primi: plur. ראשנות. Fœm. ex alia forma ראשנית.
רשית ראשית f. Principium, Primum, Primi-tia, Praestantissimum.
רבב Multum, Copiosum, Plurimum esse, Multiplicari: item Jaculari, quod a רבבה habet. Pyhal Partic. מרבבות In myriades audta, Psal. 144. 13, à Nomine quod Myriadem significat.

רב m. Multus, Magnus, Amplus: Magister, magis sciens quàm alii: Multum, Magnum; Multum, Satis: Plur. רבים Multi, Magni, Magnates: item jaculatores. Fœmin. רבה Multa, Magna: plural. רבות. Alia forma, fœm. רבת Multa, Multum, unde cum Joth paragogico רבתי.
רבא m. Chal. idem: רב וחזוה Et aspectus ejus major erat, Dan. 4. 20: רב חרטמיא Magister

page.notes: Hebrew words transcribed as legible; some vowel points and small letters in the Hebrew are uncertain, particularly in the lines beginning ראשון and רבב. The line ending "Magister" is partly obscured by a stain at right.
